name: passbook-page
description: An open bank passbook page lying on the field: printed column heads, entries printed dot-matrix style one line at a time (printer buzz), running balance computed, the final balance circled in blue ballpoint. Debits red, credits green. The most Chillar object there is — strong as frame 1 (printed:true) or as the growing-receipt meter. grow (default true; ignored when printed:true) fits the paper to the lines printed so far while an invisible ghost reserves the final layout; grow:false shows the full page at once. size (px, default 38) is the row text size; column heads are always 36+ px.
